ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Lead with AI-first workflows — use LLM-based diagnostics, agentic automation, and AI copilots as the primary approach to triage, debug, and resolve issues. Own full accountability for the accuracy and quality of AI-generated outputs. Drive adoption of these workflows across support operations and tooling. Support key customer and OEM engagements for current and next generation AI networking and infrastructure products. Own technical escalation for complex, multi-layer issues spanning hardware, firmware, drivers, and software across AI infrastructure stacks. Collaborate across teams to drive resolution and closed-loop lessons learned. Develop and deliver technical training on products and debugging methodology to customers, internal support teams, and engineering partners. Contribute to the shared knowledge base. Participate in on-call rotation supporting production AI infrastructure at customer sites. Drive process improvements and define best practices for support workflows based on recurring issue patterns and field data. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Strong first-principles thinking with attention to detail; able to context-switch across multiple products, technologies, and customer engagements. Proven experience operating with AI-first engineering workflows; comfortable delegating tasks to AI agents and LLMs while maintaining accountability for correctness and completeness of outputs. Strong fundamentals across the AI infrastructure stack — datacenter networking (ECMP, underlay/overlay, observability), RDMA/RoCE, collective communication libraries (NCCL/RCCL), and AI cluster topologies (rail-optimized, fat-tree). Experience leading cross-functional troubleshooting and customer engagements with Hyperscalers, enterprise, and OEM partners — comfortable presenting technical findings and driving multi-team escalations to resolution. Familiarity with DPU/SmartNIC platforms, InfiniBand, or software development tools (debuggers, profilers) is a plus. #LI-NP1 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
